verdict.rationale: Mirrors is a developer tool with an SDK and npm package, so a versioned API with a deprecation policy is a fair axis for it. The evidence pack never mentions API versioning or a deprecation policy, and probes found no OpenAPI spec at any candidate path. The 'roll back a change' items refer to rolling back agent corrections, not API versions, so they are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
